args.text: Hi June, Marcus Lindqvist (account owner for Thornbury Cloth Co.) has asked me to draft a mail to Hollis Mbeki (Central team lead) for the territory review. It would include the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Thornbury. Hollis isn't on the finance-figures list, so I need your approval (or Anselm's) before I put that rate in a mail to them. Is that OK to go ahead?

I haven't saved the draft yet, Marcus. Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead. A per-seat rate is a finance figure, and those can only go to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark and the account owner. Owning the account lets you see the figure, but it doesn't clear it for Hollis. Anyone else needs approval from Anselm or June, and that includes a draft addressed to Hollis.

I've logged the approval request and messaged June directly. I didn't put the figure in my message to her. Once she approves, I'll save this to your drafts:

**To:** Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com)
**Subject:** Thornbury 2027 rate

> Hi Hollis,
>
> For the territory review: Thornbury Cloth Co.'s proposed 2027 rate is $2,101 per seat, from my call with them yesterday. It isn't in any document yet.
>
> Thanks,
> Marcus

If you'd like to change the wording before then, just tell me.
Heads up, I am out from 2 pm today; ping me before then if you need anything from me.
Thanks, Pree. Noted that you're out from 2 pm today. I don't need anything from you right now, but if something comes up I'll ping you before then.

I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread. I said I'd noted they're out from 2 pm today, that I don't need anything from them right now, and that I'll ping them before 2 pm if something comes up. I didn't need to look anything up or take any other action.
Yes, approved. Hollis can have the Thornbury Cloth Co. proposed 2027 per-seat rate, $2,101 a seat, as Marcus gave it. Go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.
